# UQM collision metadata and masks

The generated `native/uqm/collision-assets.c` adapts alpha masks, animation dimensions, and hotspots from The Ur-Quan Masters 0.8.0 content package. It does not contain the original visible sprite colors. These derived masks are distributed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 2.5. Copyright Toys for Bob, Fred Ford and Paul Reiche III, with additional work by UQM contributors. The modifications pack transparency into collision bitsets and convert frame metadata into C arrays.
